_comment: CRON-86: Spirit wolf (灵狼) — forest/mountain predator. Spawns in Zhao mountains and forests, plus the Jue Ming Valley (决明谷, formerly Forest of Distorted Sense — remapped in CRON-79 for canon purity). Wolves hunt rabbits and deer. Weight 6 = uncommon predator. Added zhao_forest (wolves are forest creatures, not just mountain).
